description: This Java source file defines the 'FeatureModified' class, representing an event for when a feature within a 'Thing' has been modified. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, accessing feature details, and serializing the event to JSON.

classes.name: FeatureModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a 'feature modified' event for a Thing, with methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and access to contained feature data.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the modified Feature associated with this event.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature that was modified.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureModified instance from a JSON string or object, extracting necessary fields and deserializing.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new FeatureModified event with specified parameters such as thing ID, feature, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision, preserving other properties.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders, preserving other properties.
